verdict.rationale: Paddle documents first-party webhooks that push real-time account event notifications to your server. Deliveries are secured with a `Paddle-Signature` header and an IP allowlist, the Node and Python SDKs include signature-verification helpers, and the hosted MCP server lets agents configure webhooks and simulate events for testing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing which event types a destination subscribes to and of delivery retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Paddle uses webhooks to push real-time notifications to your server when things happen in your account.
All webhooks sent by Paddle include a `Paddle-Signature` header. Paddle generates this header using a secret key that only you and Paddle know.
Generate integration code, configure webhooks, and simulate events for testing.
It ships with TypeScript definitions, iterator-based pagination, and helpers for webhook signature verification.
